WITH canonical_pois AS (
  SELECT
    p.id AS poi_id,
    p.poi_type,
    COALESCE(cg.name, ts.common_site_name, pf.name) AS name,
    COALESCE(cg.location->>'region', ts.region, pf.region) AS region,
    COALESCE(cg.location->>'country', ts.country::text, pf.country::text) AS country,
    ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
    ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat,
    pc.campground_id,
    pts.tesla_supercharger_id,
    ppf.planet_fitness_location_id,
    cg.status AS campground_status,
    ts.site_status AS tesla_site_status,
    ts.stall_count,
    ts.max_power_kw,
    count(DISTINCT cs.id) AS campsite_count,
    max(a.last_observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at
  FROM pois p
  LEFT JOIN poi_campgrounds pc ON pc.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN campgrounds cg ON cg.id = pc.campground_id AND cg.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN campsites cs ON cs.campground_id = cg.id AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN availability a ON a.campsite_id = cs.id
  LEFT JOIN poi_tesla_superchargers pts ON pts.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN tesla_superchargers ts ON ts.id = pts.tesla_supercharger_id AND ts.deleted_at IS NULL
  LEFT JOIN poi_planet_fitness_locations ppf ON ppf.poi_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN planet_fitness_locations pf ON pf.id = ppf.planet_fitness_location_id AND pf.deleted_at IS NULL
  WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY p.id, p.poi_type, cg.id, ts.id, pf.id, pc.campground_id, pts.tesla_supercharger_id, ppf.planet_fitness_location_id
)
SELECT *
FROM canonical_pois
WHERE (${poi_name:sqlstring} = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND CASE
    WHEN ${poi_id:sqlstring} = '' THEN true
    WHEN ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring}
    ELSE false
  END
  AND (${poi_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR poi_type IN (${poi_type:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY name ASC NULLS LAST, poi_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  s.id AS snapshot_id,
  s.campsite_id,
  s.run_id,
  s.target_date,
  s.status::text AS status,
  (s.status = 'available') AS available,
  s.last_observed_at,
  lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.campsite_id, s.target_date ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from
FROM availability s
WHERE ${campsite_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND s.campsite_id::text = ${campsite_id:sqlstring}
ORDER BY s.last_observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT 500;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.target_date,
    s.last_observed_at,
    s.status,
    lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.target_date ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from
  FROM availability s
  WHERE ${campsite_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND s.campsite_id::text = ${campsite_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.last_observed_at >= now() - (${window_hours:sqlstring} || ' hours')::interval
)
SELECT
  target_date,
  count(*) AS total_runs,
  max(last_observed_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'available') AS last_open_at,
  (array_agg((status = 'available') ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, id DESC))[1] AS is_currently_open,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'available' AND coalesce(observed_from, last_observed_at) >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS opens_last_24h
FROM scoped
GROUP BY target_date
ORDER BY target_date ASC;
